subject: Converting Covariance Matrix to Genetic Correlation Matrix

messages.author: 2f3a6bdbc087eaa4
messages.subject: Converting Covariance Matrix to Genetic Correlation Matrix
parts:
Is there any way I can convert the LDSCoutput$S Matrix to a Genetic Correlation Matrix with the diagonal terms being 1 and the off diagonals representing genetic correlation?

Best,

Anthony

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Converting Covariance Matrix to Genetic Correlation Matrix
parts:
Hi Anthony, 

If you run cov2cor(LDSCoutput$S) that will convert it to a correlation matrix. 

Best, 
  Andrew
